poetryFrame.leftVertical: THOUSAND MILES SEEMS LIKE A VAST GAP OF WATER,
poetryFrame.rightVertical: BUT OUR VOICES WILL BRIDGE THE DISTANCE WITH MUSIC AND TIME.
poetryFrame.bottomLine: WE ARE BOUND BY WHAT WE FEEL TONIGHT.
sonnetLines: Across the miles where concrete sleeps,
The passing years a promise keeps,
More precious than all waking dreams.
We ride the rails of what we know,
Through amber lights and fading blue,
Though time may stretch or currents pull,
Our whispered vows remain the guide,
A love that makes the spirit full,
We wait for dawn on separate shores,
